name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Automation | HubSpot Workflows, Lead Scoring & Routing, Deliverability
summary: Marketing automation builder who turns strategy into workflows that run without breaking. I build lead scoring, lifecycle stages, routing, and multi-touch nurture in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, sync marketing automation to the CRM, and debug integrations myself through webhooks, APIs, and JSON. I set up email authentication and warm-up myself at 99%+ deliverability, work in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and use the OpenAI and Claude APIs inside production workflows.

experience.title: Marketing Automation Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built a 20+ workflow automation system: lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, reactivation, and review requests across email and SMS.
Build lead scoring, qualification criteria, and lifecycle stages in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, with marketing-to-CRM syncs and strict data hygiene.
Integrate automation with outside systems through Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks, and REST APIs, writing JavaScript and Python in custom code steps and debugging failures myself.
Set up sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and warm-up, holding deliverability above 99%, and configure cookie consent on client sites.
Build monitoring that catches broken or underperforming automation logic, and enforce UTM conventions for clean attribution.
